note: Cleveland NF campground in oak and chaparral on Hwy 79 north of Warner Springs, across from the fire station; two loops, Oak and Ribbonwood. Hot in summer. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + catalog + availability + FS page + imagery read. 63 non-electric sites, every one posted 25 ft on rec.gov (FS says 32), flush (Ribbonwood) and vault (Oak) toilets, drinking water, no showers; $15 single / $30 double, $5 extra vehicle; open all year. Keep; not waterfront unchanged; pin OK. Phone unchanged.
